Scene: dusk at a lantern-lit starting city, viewed from a stone overlook above timber-and-stone rooftops, a river and arched bridges. Constraints: no lettering, no words, no logos, no interface, no watermark, no collage, no split panels, no farming scene, no frontal full-body character pose, no glowing neon circles everywhere. Generate the actual final artwork, not a web mockup.
